name: Calendar
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Thunderbird is the Omarchy calendar hub: one default calendar aggregates every calendar (e-mail CalDAV, Nextcloud, local), combine merges scattered events into it, and promote makes it authoritative over the rest.

features: All Thunderbird calendars behind one configurable default calendar
Aggregated view: events from every calendar merged, default wins on collision
combine merges events that only exist in non-default calendars into the default (dry-run default)
promote makes the default authoritative, overwriting the same UID elsewhere
Reads the Thunderbird calendar store directly (microsecond times, expanded recurrence)
Follows the applied Omarchy theme palette, no hardcoded colours
Hyprland keybinding to show upcoming events
Nextcloud CalDAV calendars as a read source, merged into the same default-calendar view
combine/promote write back over CalDAV too (PUT) when the default is a Nextcloud calendar
